rules.universe: age <= 6 h; DEX pumpfun/pumpswap/raydium*/meteora*; liq >= 40k; vol5m >= 25k; holders >= 300; mint+freeze closed; LP of the TRADED pool BURNED, verified on chain (LP mint supply == 0); a lock without verifiable 30-day duration fails (RugCheck lockers carry no usable dates)
rules.signals: VOL_SPIKE (avg over existing 5-min windows when < 1 h), BUY_RATIO > 70 % (>= 20 txns), HOLDER_GROWTH >= 10 %/10 min, SMART_MONEY >= 3 tracked wallets in 10 min, KOL bought in 10 min (no wallet list -> UNKNOWN, never counted); >= 2
rules.rug: dev < 5 % (creator address), top10 < 35 % raw incl. AMM, bundle proxy, sell simulation of the exact amount PASS
rules.no_chase: +300 % in 1 h without >= 10 % pullback from the 1 h high (GeckoTerminal 5 m candles of the traded pool; unknown -> skip)
rules.sizer: equity-based 20/30/40 % for 2/3/>=4 signals, x0.5 after 2 losses in a row, compounding, max 2 open, $70 paper
rules.execution: 2 tranches each with its own Jupiter quote, 2.5 % cap, +$0.02/swap; exits only via passing sell simulation of the exact amount; FAIL -> imputed $0; UNKNOWN -> retry
rules.exits: 40 % at 2x, 30 % at 4x, 25 % trailing rest, hard stop -12 %, time stop 25 min, DEV_SELL only when a creator transaction is a confirmed SELL swap of the mint (balance drop alone = DEV_BALANCE_DROP log, no exit); LP pull impossible with burned LP (liquidity drop >= 50 % = LIQ_DROP_50 log, no exit)
rules.session: entries 23:00-07:00 Europe/Bucharest; 07:00 recap; 30 % drawdown from session peak -> pause entries
rules.baseline: paired random draw among same-cycle pairs passing universe + safety, same sizing/exits

wallets: LISTA LIPSA (no wallet with a documented public source)
